title: Hermes Evolution Step-Level Failure Codebook
reference: Annotrace: A Workbench for Step-Level Annotation of Agent Traces (arXiv:2610.23284)

delegation.description: Steps that dispatch or delegate execution to subagents, child tasks, or external execution tiers.

timeout.description: Delegated subagent or sub-task execution exceeded the wall-clock deadline or loop-guard execution budget.

context_overflow.description: Delegated payload or cumulative subagent conversation exceeded the context length or prompt token limit.

recursion_limit.description: Delegation cycle or call-depth threshold reached (e.g., A -> B -> A or nested subagent depth >= limit).

subagent_crash.description: Subagent process terminated abnormally with an unhandled exception or runtime crash.
signals: internal runtime error in child task

contract_violation.description: Subagent returned a malformed response, missing required schema attributes, or violated the expected task contract.
signals: schema validation failed on subagent result

unauthorized_delegation.description: Delegation rejected by access policy, missing delegation capabilities, or target role disallowed.
signals: delegation not permitted for current role

other_delegation_failure.description: Unclassified delegation anomalies that do not match the above mutually exclusive classes.

tool_call.description: Steps invoking environment tools (file access, code execution, search, patching, terminal).

precondition_failed.description: Tool invocation preconditions not met (file not found, invalid arguments, indentation mismatch, missing patch anchor).

permission_denied.description: Invocation blocked by environment permissions, protected path guards, or safety policies.

execution_error.description: Tool ran but execution failed with a non-zero exit code or internal command error.

timeout.description: Tool execution was terminated after exceeding the allotted runtime timeout.

output_unparsable.description: Tool stdout/output could not be parsed into expected structured data or JSON envelope.

quota_exceeded.description: Rate limits, token quotas, or billing credit limits encountered during tool execution.

other_tool_failure.description: Unclassified tool failures that do not match the above mutually exclusive classes.

gate_decision.description: Steps evaluating automated quality, safety, evidence, or regression gates.

evidence_mismatch.description: Claim rejected because supplied evidence is absent, non-factual, unsupported, or of incompatible type.

safety_violation.description: Gate rejected candidate due to safety policy, prompt injection, or sensitive content exposure.

regression_detected.description: Candidate introduces quality regressions, broken test suites, or performance score degradation.

policy_rejected.description: Candidate violated structural repo invariants, code style policies, or budget limits.

holdout_failed.description: Candidate failed generalization on the holdout evaluation trace set.

other_gate_failure.description: Unclassified gate rejections that do not match the above mutually exclusive classes.
